subject: Post-call: Success Scorecard & Trial Runbook for Meridian Health POC
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Success Scorecard & Trial Runbook for Meridian Health POC

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on the goals. Quick recap and a proposed small-run trial runbook so we can get an operational readout within 3 weeks. Attached: Meridian_Metrics_Template.xlsx (template for KPIs) and a draft mutual action plan.

Top-level success signals (proposal):
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end inference latency < 300 ms for median request size (~800 tokens).
- Throughput: Sustained throughput >= 50 req/sec at 1k-token avg with P95 latency < 500 ms during a 10-minute sustained window.
- Cost: Average cost/token <= $0.002 (targeting quantized variant + batching).
- Quality: Automated eval (task-specific F1/EM) and human-annotated sample pass rate >= 92% on acceptance prompts.

Evaluation plan (short):
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + dataset handoff. Meridian provides 3 representative datasets (prod-sampled, edge cases, and hallucination benchmarks).
2) Week 1: Baseline ingest + model variant smoke: run our standard models (base/quantized) and populate the Metrics Template.
3) Week 2: Load testing and stress window (sustained 10-min windows) to measure throughput and latency SLOs; iterate batching params.
4) Week 3: Quality readout + joint review (Redwood & Meridian) — finalize acceptance decision.

Owners (suggested):
- Data ingestion & dataset mapping: Avery / Meridian DS
- Benchmarks & quality evaluation: Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Performance & cost tuning: Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Trial orchestration & timelines: Soojin Lee (Redwood) / Priyom Das (ops)

Immediate asks for Monday kickoff:
- Avery: share a redacted sample of the three datasets linked to the Drive folder above.
- Meridian: confirm any tokenization expectations or pre/post-processing steps we should mirror.
- Redwood: we'll circulate a short mutual action plan with milestones and a calendar for the 3-week run.

Attachments referenced as stubs: [Meridian_Metrics_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [mutual_action_plan_draft.md (markdown)].

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Monday 10am PT unless you prefer a different time.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Soojin — this is exactly the structure we were hoping for. A couple quick notes:
- We'll share redacted CSVs tonight (PHI removed) to the Drive link. Expect ~4k examples for the prod-sample, ~800 edge cases, and a 200-row hallucination set with known ground truth.
- Tokenization: we have a custom pre-tokenizer that strips clinical codes; we can ship a pre-processing script.
- Regarding cost: Meridian's procurement needs an initial estimate to justify the trial; can Redwood provide a conservative projected cost estimate range (per 1k tokens) based on the 3 model variants?

Also, can we move the kickoff to Monday 11am PT? Our DS team has a standing conflict at 10.

Avery Collins

Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Success Scorecard & Trial Runbook for Meridian Health POC

Perfect — Monday 11am PT works. We'll update the calendar invite. A few clarifications and responses to the procurement ask:

Projected cost guidance (conservative ranges, per 1k tokens):
- Full float baseline model: $0.006 - $0.009 per 1k tokens
- 8-bit quantized variant: $0.0025 - $0.004 per 1k tokens
- Aggressive quant + batching (pilot config): ~ $0.0018 - $0.0025 per 1k tokens

These are estimates that assume our recommended batching (dynamic batching target 64 requests) and prefix cache disabled for the baseline. We'll run a short tokenized sample during Week 1 to produce a tighter projection tied to your actual token distributions.

Internal action items (assigning):
- Ben: prepare perf/runbook knobs and a short script for running 10-min sustained windows (owner: ben_carter).
- Monica: prepare the automated eval harness and create the acceptance prompt pack (owner: monica_patel).
- Priyom: reserve a small dedicated test pool and document the network topology for the trial (owner: priyom_das).

I'll circulate the updated mutual action plan and a calendar invite for Monday 11am PT. Thanks, team.

—
Soojin

Noted — I’ve dropped the perf scripts into the Drive folder and added a short README for running the 10-min sustained window. Files: perf_runner.sh (bash) and load_profile.json.

Quick checklist I ran through while prepping:
- Batching: default target 64 (we'll adjust down if P95 spikes).
- KV cache: off for initial run to measure cold-start latency; we can toggle for cost/latency trade-off after baseline.
- Monitoring: pushing token-level traces and P95/P99 latency to the trial dashboard (link above).

Next: I'll sync with Priyom to provision the pool later today.
